base_act_title.value: Tijorat banklarida korporativ boshqaruv toʻgʻrisidagi nizom (Regulation on Corporate Governance in Commercial Banks), approved by CB Board resolution 12/8 of 25.05.2020
base_act_title.quote: Tijorat banklarida korporativ boshqaruv toʻgʻrisidagi nizomni tasdiqlash haqida

prior_amendments.number: 3254-1 (CB Board resolution 19/8 of 08.07.2026, amending the preamble)

applies_to.value: Commercial banks, including microfinance banks and banks conducting Islamic banking
applies_to.quote: Mazkur Nizom tijorat banklarida, shu jumladan mikromoliya banklarida, shuningdek islomiy bank faoliyatini amalga oshiruvchi banklar va mikromoliya banklarida

change_count.explanation: The annex has 10 numbered items (amending paras 2, 3, 5, 8, 11, 15, 16, 19, 53 and adding Chapter 81). Change marks in the legal database were not counted, since the edition snapshot was not compared.

changes.summary_en: Audit committee: a majority of members must not be related persons of the bank (board membership aside), and the chair must be an independent board member and not the board chair.
changes.significance_reason: Constrains board committee composition and control rights. A PE owner's nominees may count as related persons and be limited on the audit committee.
changes.difficulty_reason: Committee and board composition may need restructuring and recruiting independent members.
changes.quote: Audit qoʻmitasining raisi kengashning mustaqil aʼzosi boʻlishi va kengash raisi boʻlmasligi lozim.

changes.summary_en: Risk committee is mandatory for systemically important banks (optional for others). If set up, a majority of members must not be related persons and the chair must be an independent board member other than the board chair.
changes.significance_reason: Affects board structure and control at systemically important banks.
changes.difficulty_reason: Requires a new committee or reconstitution and independent directors.
changes.quote: bunda mazkur qoʻmitani tashkil etish tizimli ahamiyatga molik banklar uchun majburiy hisoblanadi.

changes.summary_en: Adds principles: capacity for objective and independent decisions, and a sufficient number of independent board members to ensure objective oversight.
changes.significance_reason: Introduces an expectation of sufficient independent directors, which affects board composition and shareholder control.
changes.difficulty_reason: The 'sufficient' threshold is undefined, so some interpretive and recruitment effort is needed.
changes.quote: bank faoliyati ustidan xolis nazoratni taʼminlash uchun kengashning yetarlicha mustaqil aʼzolari mavjudligi;

changes.summary_en: Banks must develop a board-approved succession and talent-pipeline plan for board, management and key staff positions. The plan is reviewed at least annually and includes contingency measures, and the board is responsible for it.
changes.significance_reason: New governance duty with moderate compliance cost. It gives the board a role in succession planning, which touches governance.
changes.difficulty_reason: A new plan, annual review and assessments are needed.
changes.quote: 81-bob. Rahbar kadrlar zaxirasini shakllantirish va rivojlantirish

changes.summary_en: Disclosure list expanded: board member selection and appointment procedures and board composition principles; bank dividend payment policy and remuneration policy; material risks; results of board and management performance.
changes.significance_reason: Added disclosure, including the dividend policy and board selection rules, which matter to investors but carry moderate cost.
changes.quote: bankning dividendlar toʻlash siyosati, shuningdek, kengash, boshqaruv aʼzolari hamda bankning muhim ahamiyatga ega xodimlarini mukofotlash siyosati va boshqalar;

changes.summary_en: Board must ensure committees work independently and review committee composition periodically, including rotating members and chairs.
changes.significance_reason: New governance duty on committee rotation.
changes.quote: shu jumladan ularning aʼzolari va raislarini rotatsiya qilish masalasini koʻrib chiqishi kerak.

changes.summary_en: Clarifies the duties of board and management members (good faith, prudence, loyalty, serving the interests of the bank and its shareholders). Adds a duty to avoid actions that may harm the bank's business reputation.
changes.significance_reason: Slightly expanded director duties that bear on nominee directors' conduct.
changes.quote: bankning ishchanlik obroʻsiga salbiy taʼsir koʻrsatishi mumkin boʻlgan har qanday xatti-harakatlarni sodir etmasligi;

changes.summary_en: Clarifications: authority, duties and responsibility must be allocated clearly in internal documents. Committee design should account for each committee's specific tasks.
changes.significance_reason: Clarifying wording without new concrete obligations.
changes.quote: bankning ichki hujjatlarida belgilanadigan vakolat, vazifalar va javobgarlikning aniq tarzda taqsimlanishi;

notes: The act is registered and published, but not yet in force (effective 2027-01-13). The 'stage' field is therefore 'published'. The act is dated 2026-09-17 (no. 24/2).
